item.title: Oil prices drop and stock markets rise after reports of deal to end Iran war
item.summary: Reports have raised hopes of an agreement between the US and Iran after days of escalation.

item.title: China calls for Strait to be reopened 'as soon as possible' in Iran talks
item.summary: Wang Yi is holding talks with Iran's foreign minister Aragchi who is on his first trip to China since the war began.

item.title: BBC traces how 10 minutes of Israeli bombing brought devastation to Lebanon
item.summary: The bombs started falling at 14:15 in the afternoon - bringing chaos and destruction across the country.

item.title: Russia ignores Ukraine's unilateral ceasefire and attacks kindergarten
item.summary: Ukraine's president says Russia has "spurned the ceasefire" and Kyiv is deciding on further action to take.

item.title: Massive Alaska megatsunami was second largest ever recorded
item.summary: New research suggests glacier melt driven by climate change is increasing the risk of giant waves.

item.title: German police raid neo-Nazi criminal youth groups
item.summary: Police search locations in 12 states, mainly in the East and South of the country in what prosecutors say is a targeted raid.

item.title: Orphaned baby hippo to be hand-reared by keepers at Kenya sanctuary
item.summary: The baby hippo, which has been named Bumpy, was found clinging to its lifeless mother at a lake.

item.title: To stay or risk the 'Road of Death' - Ukrainian civilians trapped in frontline city
item.summary: People in the Ukrainian city of Oleshky say they have been cut off from fresh supplies of food or medicine for months.

item.title: Vivek Ramaswamy wins Republican nomination for Ohio governor
item.summary: The staunch Trump ally emerged victorious in one of a series of closely-watched primary contests held in the US Midwest.

item.title: Ted Turner, media mogul who revolutionised TV news by launching CNN, dies at 87
item.summary: The media mogul pioneered the modern 24-hour news culture when he launched the Cable News Network in 1980.
